name: Page Summarizer
summary: Summarize websites with local and cloud LLMs
detailed_description: Page Summarizer lets you extract and summarize web page content using local or cloud LLMs. Configure your provider in Options. See PRIVACY.md for details.
release_notes: Rebranded to Page Summarizer; added configurable page truncation (default 8000 chars) and token estimate; security fixes and sanitizer improvements.
